gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
